def plan_recordings(shows, k):
    """Choose which shows to record using at most k tuners.

    shows is a list of triples (start, end, weight) of integers with
    0 <= start < end <= 10**9 and 1 <= weight <= 10**6; len(shows) <= 60.
    k is an integer with 1 <= k <= 4.  Show i occupies the half-open time
    interval [start, end), so a show ending at time t does NOT conflict
    with a show starting at time t.

    A set of shows is feasible if at every instant t at most k chosen
    shows are on the air (start <= t < end).  Equivalently, the chosen
    shows can be split among k tuners so that the shows on each single
    tuner are pairwise non-overlapping.

    Return a tuple (W, ids) where W is the maximum possible total weight
    of a feasible set, and ids is the sorted list of 0-based indices of
    the greedily preferred optimal set, defined index by index: for
    i = 0, 1, 2, ..., include show i if and only if some maximum-weight
    feasible set contains every index already included, no index already
    rejected, and i.  (Equivalently: among all maximum-weight feasible
    sets, ids is the one maximizing sum(2**(len(shows)-1-i) for i in ids).)

    An empty shows list gives (0, []).

    >>> plan_recordings([(0, 3, 5), (1, 4, 6), (2, 5, 7)], 1)
    (7, [2])
    >>> plan_recordings([(0, 3, 5), (1, 4, 6), (2, 5, 7)], 2)
    (13, [1, 2])
    >>> plan_recordings([(0, 2, 4), (0, 2, 4), (2, 4, 4)], 1)
    (8, [0, 2])
    """
